messages:
alice: Kicking off late canary for a config-only limiter tweak. Change window 22:30-23:30 PT. Target: reduce tail latency spikes by adjusting routing shard weights and per-tenant qps cap. @ben_release @ops-sre :eyes:

deploy-bot: Started canary deploy 1725049998 for CONFIG: limiter.v1 -> limiter.v1.1 (traffic 0.5%)

ben_release: Rolling at 0.5% for 15m, will step to 5% after green. Observability: per-route p50/p95, error-rate, kvcache-pressure.

carla: quick note — do NOT change batching params in this window. Only routing + rate cap in this patch.

ops-sre: Watching infra metrics. If tail latency > 250ms or 5xx > 0.5% rollback immediately. If kvcache evictions spike > 10k/5m, escalate.

david: Manual rollback pin prepared. If rollback: pin routing policy to 'stable-2026-02-14' and limiter -> limiter.v1. I'll paste command.

alice: rollback command:
```bash
./infractl rollout set-config --policy stable-2026-02-14 --limiter limiter.v1 --comment "auto-rollback from late canary"
```

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ 10m: p95 +12ms, errors 0.12%, kvcache evictions +2k. No action needed.

ben_release: :thumbsup: proceed to 5% in 10m. @ops-sre please confirm.

ops-sre: Confirming. Stepping to 5% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic adjustment: canary 0.5% -> 5% (timestamp 1725050400).

carla: FYI added to release notes draft: "config-only limiter tweak: increased per-tenant qps floor to smooth tail latency; no code changes." 

ops-sre: 30m check: seeing minor latency improvement, no error increase. Will monitor additional 60m before bump to 25%.

deploy-bot: Canary stage (60m) complete: metrics stable. Recommend rollout 25% next.

ben_release: Recommend ramp plan: 25% -> 50% after 30m -> 100% after 2h if green. Add auto-rollback rule: error_rate>0.5% for 10m.

alice: Agreed. Tagging @david for handoff to oncall after 100% and adding note: "observability thresholds set; auto-rollback rules in place."

david: Ack. I'll be on standby for final 100% rollout and have rollback pinned.

ops-sre: Final ops note: If we see Kinesis/backpressure signs, pause rollout and revert batching window to previous config. Will call outage channel if needed.
